name: Uno shared family memory
description: Shared family memory, shared skills and the USER.md save tool.

dir.description: Folder of the shared store, outside every agent workspace. It must also be in each agent's memory.search.extraPaths. Default ~/.openclaw/uno-data/family-memory.

names.description: Agent id -> the person's first name, stamped on each shared note so everyone can see whose chat it came from. Unset: no name.

skillsDir.description: Folder of shared skills, loaded by every agent through skills.load.extraDirs. Default ~/.openclaw/uno-data/shared-skills.

sharedSites.description: Sites a skill must stick to, to be shared. Unset: uno-guard's sharedSites.
